verdict.rationale: GoDaddy documents an official CLI (`gddy`) with install/auth setup, example commands (e.g., `gddy dns set example.com --type A`), and an explicit agent-skill integration letting AI agents run gddy commands under a user's authenticated session — a clear AI-native CLI story. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the CLI's real-world behavior and community corroboration beyond first-party docs.
